a.title: Fortinet sounds the alarm over actively exploited FortiMail zero-day

b.lede: Fortinet is warning customers of a critical FortiMail vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-104286, that is being actively exploited in zero-day attacks to execute unauthorized code or commands on vulnerable devices. [...]
